experiment: Identical pretrained YOLO26n/config, fixed POS_8091164 validation; baseline uses 5 original training towers/30 insulators, expanded arm adds POS_6610209/7 morphology-diverse insulators for 6 towers/37 insulators.
decision: Do not spend further CPU epochs on closed-set YOLO26 fine-tuning at 6-source/37-box scale. Keep YOLO26 as a future deployment candidate once labelled source diversity is materially larger; use YOLOE open-vocabulary proposals/foundation features for the current active-learning data-acquisition cycle.
claim_boundary: Very small development ablation; zero AP is evidence of current data insufficiency, not a general statement about YOLO26.
